description:
Add a new "query latency histogram" chart type that displays one vertical bar per query,
showing the execution latency for each query. This provides a quick visual overview of
query performance distribution across a benchmark run.

When more than ~33 queries are graphed, the visualization should automatically split
into multiple charts to maintain readability. This is particularly useful for TPC-DS
(99 queries) where a single chart would be too dense.
